about_the_game:
The year is 2000. Officers Tim Rieff and Kim Hansbury are dispatched to the remote Redwood Estate after losing contact with fellow officers Jason Hayes and Tammy Becker. What begins as a routine investigation quickly spirals into a nightmare, as they uncover a horrifying scene beyond anything they could have imagined. To locate their missing colleagues and rescue any remaining survivors, Tim and Kim must arm themselves and confront the dark secrets lurking within the estate.

  • Classic survival horror game.

  • Explore the manor and its surroundings in search of your missing fellow officers. Uncover the mysterious events that led to the tragic fate of the residents and staff of the Redwood Estate in this atmospheric survival horror experience.

  • Search every corner for the tools you’ll need to survive against terrifying enemies while carefully managing your limited resources.

  • Immersive original soundtrack fully composed in-house to pull you deeper into the horror.

content_descriptors.notes: This game may contain content not appropriate for all ages. Frequent violence or gore and general mature content.

short_description: Investigate the Redwood Estate as officers Tim Rieff and Kim Hansbury in this classic top-down survival horror game. Face terrifying creatures, manage scarce resources, and uncover the dark secrets behind the mysterious events that took place within the estate.
